items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: I went to Boat Played on his kid, I said, with Freed and all

ctx.x: I guess New Orleans was really always a part of his temper and his style every place he went

Oh yeah, well, but See, when Kid Ory had this thing going on before either King Oliver was playing with Ory And when Oliver got a chance to go to New York, Chicago Ory was a young fellow player around here He used to hang around with him all the time Go around, he used to fame So he said, get that boy He was a young man, he said, get a kid They called him a kid too Everybody, when he was young, they called him a kid He would take that name, some guys kept that name going Kid so and so Ory never wanted to be a kid…
